summary: One-click Markdown clipper. Save pages and selections as clean Markdown with images, frontmatter, preview, copy, and download.

website.description: Save pages and selections as clean Markdown.

singlePurpose: Convert the current webpage or selected content into Markdown and let the user preview, copy, or download the result.

permissions.name: activeTab
permissions.justification: Temporarily accesses the current tab only after the user clicks the extension or selects an extension context menu action, so the page can be converted to Markdown.

permissions.name: contextMenus
permissions.justification: Adds right-click actions so users can clip selected webpage content as Markdown.

permissions.name: downloads
permissions.justification: Saves user-requested Markdown files or ZIP files containing Markdown and local image assets.

permissions.name: offscreen
permissions.justification: Creates Blob URLs for Markdown and ZIP downloads because Manifest V3 service workers cannot create DOM Blob object URLs.

permissions.name: scripting
permissions.justification: Runs the Markdown clipping script only after the user invokes the extension on the current tab.

permissions.name: storage
permissions.justification: Stores the user's Images and Template clipping preferences so popup and context menu actions use the same options.

remoteCode.justification: The extension does not use remote code. All executable JavaScript and CSS is included in the submitted package.

store.description:
One-click Markdown web clipper for saving pages and selections as clean, portable Markdown.

OSBE Markdown Clipper helps you capture useful web content for AI agents, LLM workflows, documentation, notes, research, and personal knowledge bases. Open the popup on any normal web page, review the generated Markdown, then copy it or download it.

CLIPPING AND CONVERSION

- Clip the current page into Markdown.
- Clip selected content from the context menu.
- Preserve headings, paragraphs, links, lists, tables, blockquotes, code blocks, and images.
- Add optional frontmatter with title, source URL, and clipping timestamp.
- Keep image links in Markdown or download page images alongside the Markdown file.

PREVIEW, COPY, AND DOWNLOAD

- Review generated Markdown directly in the popup.
- Toggle between Markdown source and rich text preview.
- Copy Markdown to the clipboard.
- Download a .md file when images are off.
- Download a .zip containing Markdown and local image assets when images are on.

OSBE Markdown Clipper runs only when you invoke it from the popup or context menu. It does not declare broad host permissions.

review.instructions:
1. Open a normal webpage containing headings, links, and body text.
2. Open OSBE Markdown Clipper from the toolbar.
3. Confirm the popup produces Markdown for the current page.
4. Switch between source and preview.
5. Copy the Markdown and confirm it reaches the clipboard.
6. Download the result and confirm Chrome saves a .md file.
7. Select text on the page, right-click it, and use the OSBE clipping action to confirm selection-only clipping.
